name: InvDesFlow-AL
one_liner: A diffusion model generates crystals, a committee of predictors and relaxation checks picks the best, and the model is fine-tuned on them.

loop.proposes: Crystal structures from a diffusion model (EGNN backbone) pretrained on Alex-MP-20 and GNoME crystals
loop.judged_by: Relaxation with DPA-2, then a committee score on formation energy and Ehull or on superconductor Tc
loop.steers: The top-scored generated crystals become the next fine-tuning set, repeated over multiple rounds

headline_result: Generated average formation energy fell over five iterations (means -1.14, -2.03, -2.93, -3.56, -3.77; units not stated in the text). The authors report 1,598,551 materials with Ehull below 50 meV, and Li2AuH6 as a conventional superconductor with a transition temperature of about 140 K from first-principles electron-phonon calculations. Crystal structure prediction RMSE is 0.0423 angstrom, reported as a 32.96% improvement over existing generative models.
caveat: The paper gives two counts for low-Ehull materials (1,598,551 in text, 1,610,600 in a figure caption) and does not say how Ehull is queried. The 140 K value is a calculation, not a measurement, and not every evaluation is DFT.
beyond_harness_note: A diffusion model is fine-tuned over rounds on crystals chosen by relaxation and learned predictors, with many crystals generated per round; DFT is used explicitly only for the superconductor task.
generative_model: Diffusion model on atom types, lattice and fractional coordinates (EGNN)
algorithmic_authority: DPA-2 relaxation, committee scoring, Bohrium Ehull query, DFT for the superconductor task

sources.title: InvDesFlow-AL: active learning-based workflow for inverse design of functional materials (arXiv:2505.09203; npj Computational Materials 11, 364, 2025)

verification.notes: Read the arXiv v2 abstract and 100,000 characters of the HTML full text; journal reference (npj Comput Mater 11, 364) and DOI taken from the arXiv record, since nature.com redirects to a login handshake. Report corrections: generator is a diffusion model; Ehull source is the Bohrium platform and the paper does not say DFT; DFT is explicit only for the superconductor task; the two Ehull counts disagree inside the paper. Successor to InvDesFlow (arXiv:2409.08065), not opened. The last 26,000 characters of the HTML were not read. Org confirmed from the arXiv HTML title block; one author also at UCAS (review 2026-11-03).
